source_title: Withholding Taxes With Envato Elements And Envato Market

snippets.snippet_text: "With Envato Market, you are selling directly to the customer. When you sell to a buyer based in a country with royalty withholding taxes, they will apply. For example, when you sell to a US buyer, the US royalty withholding tax applies."
